big_story.headline: Jio's Mega IPO Breaks Records
big_story.subhead: INDIA'S LARGEST PUBLIC ISSUE IS SUBSCRIBED OVER THREE TIMES ON ITS VERY FIRST DAY
paragraphs: India's largest public issue, the Jio Platforms IPO, made a historic debut on October 21, 2026. The initial public offering was fully subscribed within just 100 minutes of going public as investor demand surged. By the end of Day 1, the issue received total bids worth ₹95,500 crore, outpacing previous record issues from LIC and NSE.

The IPO attracted ₹70,000 crore in bids early on Day 1, with strong demand driven primarily by Qualified Institutional Buyers. By Day 2, the grey market premium stood at 22%, reflecting sustained interest among market participants. Meanwhile, shares of parent company Reliance Industries gained over 1% after the subscription opened.

With total subscription reaching 3.16 times on its opening day, the massive issue marks a landmark moment for Indian capital markets. Market observers are closely monitoring live subscription status and brokerage views as bidding continues. The overwhelming appetite underscores strong institutional confidence in the telecom and tech conglomerate.
big_story.pullbox: Jio's mega public issue achieved full subscription in 100 minutes and received ₹95,500 crore in Day 1 bids, setting a new benchmark for Indian market debuts.

explains.title: What is a Grey Market Premium?
paragraphs: A Grey Market Premium, or GMP, is the extra price at which an IPO's shares are traded in an unofficial, over-the-counter market before they are formally listed on stock exchanges. It reflects unofficial investor demand and sentiment prior to official listing.
Investors track the GMP to gauge expected listing gains and market enthusiasm. A positive percentage indicates that buyers are willing to pay a premium over the official issue price band.

AI hiring startup Hunar.AI has raised ₹39.3 crore in a fresh funding round led by venture capital firm Blume Ventures. The startup builds artificial intelligence tools aimed at automating and improving recruitment workflows for enterprise clients.

The newly raised capital will support Hunar.AI in enhancing its product capabilities and expanding its market footprint. Strong backing from Blume Ventures highlights growing investor confidence in specialized AI platforms targeting talent acquisition.

story_1.headline: Sensex tumbles 600 points as Nifty tests 22,600
paragraphs: The Indian stock market saw a sharp correction in early trade today as the Sensex dropped significantly and the Nifty touched the 22,600 mark. Investors reacted to a combination of macroeconomic headwinds and unfolding domestic developments.
Market analysts note that selling pressure spanned across multiple key sectors as cautious sentiment took hold among institutional and retail participants alike.

story_2.headline: India bond selloff to continue as RBI hints at hikes
paragraphs: Indian bond yields are expected to remain under upward pressure following the release of the latest Reserve Bank of India policy minutes. The central bank commentary points firmly toward further tightening measures.
Traders are adjusting portfolios as short-term yields surge and monetary policy signals a cautious approach toward controlling inflation and stabilising the rupee.

story_3.headline: Stock market outlook: Cues from global indices
paragraphs: Market participants are closely monitoring overnight moves in major global benchmarks including the DJIA, S&P, NASDAQ, and Nikkei to gauge sentiment for Indian indices.

geopolitics.headline: India-US Trade Deal Nears Completion as Marco Rubio Visits
paragraphs: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio has arrived in India for a three-day visit as both nations edge closer to finalising a trade agreement. Donald Trump noted that the trade deal is pretty close, while Secretary Rubio signaled a strategic breakthrough during his visit. Discussions are heavily focused on energy diplomacy and trade ties during the high-level engagement.

Despite current optimism, reports highlight past friction and trust deficits that previously stalled bilateral negotiations. A finalized agreement could reshape bilateral commerce and provide regulatory stability for cross-border investments. Businesses and investors are now watching key deal contours as trade delegations finalize terms.

big_story.headline: RBI Rejects All T-Bill Bids as Yields Surge
big_story.text: The Reserve Bank of India rejected all bids at a treasury bill auction as short-term yields surged. This unexpected move by the central bank signals growing liquidity pressures and impacts short-term borrowing costs across the domestic financial markets.

venture_vault.headline: Karta AI Secures $3M to Automate BFSI Calls
venture_vault.text: Enterprise startup Karta AI has successfully raised $3 million in a seed round to automate complex voice calls in the BFSI sector. This funding will accelerate product development, helping financial institutions streamline customer interactions through advanced conversational AI.

venture_vault.headline: Bengaluru Travel Startup Onto Bags $1 Million
venture_vault.text: Bengaluru-based travel startup Onto has raised $1 million in a pre-seed funding round led by Stargazer Fund. The fresh capital will fuel its expansion strategy, offering fresh opportunities in India's competitive consumer-tech and travel landscape.

geopolitics.headline: India-New Zealand FTA Grants Zero-Duty Access
geopolitics.text: The India-New Zealand FTA has officially come into force, granting Indian goods zero-duty access to the island nation. This landmark trade agreement promises to boost bilateral commerce and open lucrative export avenues for Indian manufacturers.
